A '''Janta knife''' was a type of [[Melee weapon/Legends|melee weapon]] that was in use at some point after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a conflict fought between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The short, crudely-made [[Knife/Legends|knife]] could be held in one [[Limb/Legends|hand]] and it dealt physical damage to objects it struck. The Janta's knife blade was [[Color/Legends|gray]] in color, while the knife's handle was brown.<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Janta knife first appeared in [[Sony]] Online Entertainment's [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'',<ref name="SWG" /> prior to ''Galaxies''{{'}} closure in [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> In the game, the knife was a melee weapon that dealt kinetic damage, and it was randomly placed in loot that players could find on some enemies that they defeated.<ref name="SWG" />

The [[Janta]] are a tribe of [[Dantari]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]] that appeared in ''Star Wars Galaxies'', but the description of the Janta knife did not mention whether the knife was used or created by them. The weapon had the same in-game model as the [[Knife/Legends|stone knife]], but the game did not say that the Janta knife was made of stone.<ref name="SWG" />
